SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "event_space" IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" >= 200;
2:
SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" = 200;
262:
SELECT
    p."title" AS position_title,
    sd."salary_range",
    sd."hourly_rate"
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
WHERE
    LOWER(p."title") LIKE LOWER('%software developer%');
266:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "minimum_years",
        "preferred_years"
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    msj."minimum_years" AS required_experience_years,
    msj."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    max_salary_job msj;
